races.paceDynamic: Expound is the sole confirmed front-runner and should get an uncontested lead through the early stages at Tramore. War Correspondent, Hasten Slowly, Lincall, Donnrua Dream and You Done Well can race prominently behind the leader, but none are aggressive pace-forcers. The lack of pace pressure means Expound can dictate at a comfortable gallop before the field bunches up approaching the business end. This sustainable pace setup strongly favours hold-up horses who can finish from off the pace, as they'll get the perfect setup to unleash late runs.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Expound sets modest fractions and the pace doesn't quicken until late.
scenarios.body: The patient hold-up runners get ideal conditions to produce their finishing kicks from the back of the field. Oh So Charming, Tell Us This, Redwood Queen and Desert Cave all benefit from the tactical scenario.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Expound Wires Field
scenarios.trigger: If the leader maintains his gallop and the chasers can't pick him up.
scenarios.body: Expound's course and distance win gives him the edge when allowed to dictate terms from the front. The prominent runners like War Correspondent and Hasten Slowly chase home but can't reel in the leader.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Pace Duel
scenarios.trigger: If War Correspondent, Hasten Slowly or others press Expound early.
scenarios.body: The increased pace stretches the field and compromises the finishing kicks of the hold-up horses. Runners who can travel well in behind the leaders like Migdam and Lincall can benefit from the stronger gallop.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Chaos in Heavy Ground
scenarios.trigger: If the yielding conditions cause multiple mistakes or falls at the hurdles.
scenarios.body: The race becomes a survival test where position and jumping accuracy matter more than pure ability. Any of the more experienced campaigners who stay on their feet can capitalise on others' misfortunes.

watchPoints.text: Expound could get too easy a lead early and prove hard to peg back if the field gives him too much rope
Oh So Charming has squeaky gate tendencies that could cost him crucial lengths at the start
Hasten Slowly's return to hurdles after disappointing AW runs could spark significant improvement
Tell Us This has been hit-and-miss lately and needs to produce his best effort to be competitive
Jack Kennedy's booking of Lincall suggests connections fancy their chances despite limited jumps experience

races.paceDynamic: Crooked Path looks the sole confirmed pace-setter with his prominent style and consistent form, likely to dictate from the front without serious early pressure in this 17-runner maiden field. The bulk of the field contains hold-up horses and unknowns, suggesting they'll settle behind and wait for their moment. With most runners looking to come from off the pace, Crooked Path can control the tempo and kick clear when ready. This pace scenario strongly favours front-runners and prominent racers who can avoid the inevitable traffic problems behind.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Crooked Path gets an uncontested lead and maintains galloping room
scenarios.body: He can dictate ideal fractions and prove too strong for the trailing pack who face a wall of horses turning for home. His consistent placed form gives him a crucial class edge over this largely unproven field.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Traffic Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the large field bunches up and creates interference in the straight
scenarios.body: The prominent runners escape the trouble while hold-up horses get hampered or find no racing room. Those who can pick their way through or find gaps late will benefit from others' misfortune.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Moderate Early Pace
scenarios.trigger: If Crooked Path goes too slow early allowing closers to build momentum
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses get the perfect setup to unleash strong finishing kicks from the back. The race becomes a sprint finish where raw ability trumps tactical positioning.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Newcomer Springs Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If one of the debutants shows significantly more ability than their breeding suggests
scenarios.body: The pace becomes irrelevant as superior class emerges from an unexpected source. Previous form lines get thrown out the window in typical maiden fashion.

watchPoints.text: Crooked Path could get too easy a lead if no other pace-setters emerge, making him very hard to peg back
Traffic problems almost guaranteed with 17 runners and most wanting to come from behind in the straight
Le Tatoue Madrik adding cheekpieces suggests connections think he needs them to show his best form
Hey Now's consistent form stands out in this weak maiden field if he can find racing room when needed
Several apprentice jockey bookings indicate trainers have low expectations for those runners

races.paceDynamic: Time Is A Thief is the only confirmed front runner in this 16-runner maiden hurdle field, likely to dictate from the front at a sustainable gallop without early pressure. The majority of runners show hold-up tendencies or unknown styles, suggesting a slowly-run race early before quickening from the back of the last hurdle. With most of the field needing to come from off the pace and many showing fade-in-finish warnings, those who can travel strongly and produce their effort late will have a significant tactical advantage. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses with proven finishing kick over prominent racers and front runners.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Slow Pace Suits Closers
scenarios.trigger: If Time Is A Thief sets uncontested fractions and the field bunches turning for home
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from the last hurdle where horses with the most natural ability can overcome their inexperience. Hold-up horses like The Monkey Pole and Lord Lackendarra benefit from their ability to quicken off a slow pace.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates Weaklings
scenarios.trigger: If Time Is A Thief maintains a strong gallop and the inexperienced field fails to mount serious pressure
scenarios.body: The De Bromhead runner uses his race experience to dictate ideal fractions and stays clear of the struggling maiden field behind. His point-to-point class and stable form give him the edge over these newcomers.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Cromwell Pair Strike Late
scenarios.trigger: If Blues Street or Deep Warrior show significant improvement from their stable's strong recent form
scenarios.body: The Gavin Cromwell yard's 5/44 recent record suggests both runners could step forward dramatically from previous efforts. Blues Street's €66,000 price tag and Deep Warrior's early promise could translate into breakthrough performances.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise Package Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If one of the lightly-raced newcomers shows unexpected ability on debut
scenarios.body: China Grill or Puck Out benefit from their strong breeding and connections' confidence in running them in competitive maiden company. The slow pace allows them to overcome inexperience and show their natural talent late.

watchPoints.text: Time Is A Thief could steal this if allowed uncontested lead given his class edge from pointing
Blues Street and Deep Warrior merit close attention as Cromwell stable shows excellent recent form at 5/44
The Monkey Pole's market support will indicate connections' confidence in his return from 227-day absence
China Grill and Puck Out represent unknown quantities with strong breeding that could surprise on debut
Lord Lackendarra's course experience and bumper form could translate to hurdles improvement at familiar venue

races.paceDynamic: Kimy is the confirmed front runner and will likely lead from flag to finish without serious pressure early. Prince Of Air and Kilbarry Ce Ce as prominent runners may track him but won't create genuine pace pressure in this 19-runner handicap. The moderate early tempo will allow hold-up horses like Bossing It, Sheer Raz, and Miss Donna to get into contention turning for home. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can produce late kicks, as the lack of early pace will create a sprint finish from the final half-mile.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is moderate as expected with Kimy uncontested
scenarios.body: The lack of pressure allows closers to position perfectly and unleash finishing kicks. Multiple hold-up horses swamp the leaders in the final furlong creating a blanket finish.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Trio Sustain
scenarios.trigger: If Prince Of Air and Kilbarry Ce Ce press Kimy creating stronger pace
scenarios.body: The increased tempo stretches the field and prevents hold-up horses from closing effectively. The early pace-setters have enough left to hold on.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Kimy Wire-To-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Kimy gets completely uncontested lead and quickens turning for home
scenarios.body: The front runner kicks clear before closers can respond and holds on grimly. His course form and tactical advantage prove decisive.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is crawling with no one willing to go forward
scenarios.body: The race becomes a messy sprint where anything can happen. Long shots get involved as class goes out the window.

races.paceDynamic: With only Jetaway Nana showing genuine front-running tendencies and Roccabaker/Lady Bluebird likely prominent, this shapes as a modest early gallop over this extended trip. The majority field comprises hold-up horses who will need the race to develop, creating a bunching effect through the middle stages. As the pace inevitably quickens from three out, those with tactical speed and the ability to improve position will hold the advantage. This race shape clearly favours horses who can track the pace prominently or improve from midfield, rather than those relying on staying-on kicks from the rear.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustainable Pace Benefits
scenarios.trigger: If Jetaway Nana sets an even tempo without serious early pressure
scenarios.body: The modest gallop allows prominent trackers to conserve energy before quickening, while hold-up horses get swamped in the kick for home. Those positioned in the first half of the field can strike decisively.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Jetaway Nana gets an uncontested lead and dictates throughout
scenarios.body: The confirmed leader uses her stamina advantage over this extended trip, making steady headway from the home turn while others struggle to peg her back. Her class edge at this level proves decisive.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace proves too conservative and the field comes together late
scenarios.body: A sprint finish develops where those with natural speed benefit, regardless of position, as stamina becomes less relevant. The race becomes tactical rather than a true staying test.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Battle Develops
scenarios.trigger: If Roccabaker or Lady Bluebird challenge Jetaway Nana for the early lead
scenarios.body: Increased early tempo stretches the field and creates a genuine staying test where those coming from behind can close strongly. The genuine gallop suits natural stayers over pure speed horses.

races.paceDynamic: River Tara is the sole genuine front-runner and will be allowed to dictate terms without early pressure from the large field. The prominent horses like Jumping Susie, Magic Day, and Faceman will track at a respectful distance, while the hold-up horses including Gunnery Sergeant and Black Soul will need the pace to develop properly. With only one pace-setter in a 13-runner beginners chase over 2m5½f, this will become a tactical affair with the real racing beginning after the final fence. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners and front-runners who can control their position throughout, as the hold-up horses will struggle to make up ground in what will likely become a sprint finish.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominance
scenarios.trigger: If River Tara maintains a strong gallop and isn't headed turning in.
scenarios.body: River Tara gets first run on the field and proves too tough to peg back, while the chasing pack arrives too late having given him too much rope. The lack of early pace pressure allows the leader to dictate ideal fractions.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Takeover
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners close on River Tara approaching the final fence.
scenarios.body: Jumping Susie or Magic Day time their challenge perfectly as River Tara begins to tire, with their class telling in the final furlong. The hold-up horses are caught too far back when the race develops.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Hold-Up Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes overly sedate and bunches the field.
scenarios.body: Gunnery Sergeant and other hold-up horses benefit from a tactical race that becomes a cavalry charge, with Jack Kennedy's big-race experience proving decisive. The lack of a strong gallop throughout plays into the hands of those with a turn of foot.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If River Tara stops quickly and the prominent horses fail to capitalize.
scenarios.body: The race becomes a messy affair with multiple horses having chances in the final 100 yards, suiting those who can quicken off a steady pace. Drop A Threat or Warriors Wood could benefit from the chaos with their trainers' tactical nous.

races.paceDynamic: Long Road and Toor Moon will dispute the early lead with both confirmed front-runners likely to set a strong gallop over this extended trip. Their clash should create an honest pace that will stretch the field, particularly given Toor Moon's recent consistency in staying on and Long Road's need to bounce back from Clonmel. The sustained gallop over 2m5½f will test stamina reserves and expose any weaklings in the closing stages. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses and closers who can pick up the pieces when the pace-setters weaken.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Late
scenarios.trigger: If Long Road and Toor Moon duel too hard early and both fade from the last
scenarios.body: The strong early gallop becomes unsustainable and the race falls apart for late-running types with stamina to capitalize. Hold-up horses like Ballybrack Wood and Let Him B can sweep past tired leaders.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Toor Moon or Long Road gets an easier lead than expected
scenarios.body: One of the pace-setters manages their effort better and has enough left to resist late challenges. Toor Moon's recent placed efforts suggest he can time his effort better than Long Road.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Lake Chad or Teescomponentsyess travel well behind the pace-setters
scenarios.body: The experienced campaigners use their tactical nous to sit closer than the hold-up brigade but avoid the early battle. Lake Chad's strong Tramore record makes him dangerous if bouncing back from Wexford.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Reserve Gets In
scenarios.trigger: If Let Him B or Opposite Ends gain a start due to withdrawals
scenarios.body: The Charles Byrnes-trained reserves are in much better form than most of these handicap chasers. Their recent hurdles wins suggest they're well ahead of their chase marks.

watchPoints.text: Watch for any late market move on Let Him B or Opposite Ends as the Charles Byrnes reserves are in much better form than most
Monitor how aggressively Long Road and Toor Moon go early as both confirmed front-runners could set up the race for closers
Keep an eye on Lake Chad's jumping as his Tramore record is strong but he disappointed badly at Wexford last time
Check if Ballybrack Wood shows any rustiness early after 477 days off despite his course winning debut
Watch the pace through the middle stages as this extended trip will expose any stamina limitations in the closing stages

races.paceDynamic: The Happy Huntsman will lead without pressure as the sole confirmed front-runner, setting his own tempo through the early stages. Six runners (Cold Old Fire, Lawful Ruler, Pirate Island, Roman Parish, Ta Se Rua) will cluster prominently behind him, creating dangerous traffic 2-3 fences from home when the pace lifts. The sustainable early gallop means stamina will tell late, with the moderate pace suiting hold-up horses who can find clear air when the prominent pack gets shuffled. This shape strongly favours hold-up performers who can avoid the prominent congestion and finish powerfully.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Benefit
scenarios.trigger: If The Happy Huntsman sets an even tempo and the prominent pack gets bunched at the business end
scenarios.body: The sustainable pace allows closers to conserve energy while prominent runners get shuffled in traffic. Clean runs from the back prove decisive as stamina kicks in up the hill.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tactical Move
scenarios.trigger: If one of the six prominent runners makes an early move to avoid the traffic
scenarios.body: Cold Old Fire or Lawful Ruler breaks clear 3-4 out before the congestion develops. Their class tells as they avoid the scramble and maintain momentum to the line.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Leader Lasts Home
scenarios.trigger: If The Happy Huntsman maintains his gallop and the prominent pack fails to organize
scenarios.body: The uncontested lead allows The Happy Huntsman to build an unassailable advantage. The moderate pace plays to his stamina strengths while prominent runners cancel each other out.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise Package Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and one of the lightly-raced runners finds significant improvement
scenarios.body: Black Dakota or Vodka Splash benefits from the crawling pace to show their true ability. The tactical nature of the race allows an unconsidered runner to slip through.

watchPoints.text: Watch for fallers in the prominent pack of six when they bunch up 2-3 fences from home
Monitor if The Happy Huntsman gets too keen early as the only leader, which could compromise his stamina
Check if Cold Old Fire or Lawful Ruler try to break clear before the traffic develops
Watch for trouble in running affecting the hold-up horses if the pace becomes too stop-start
Observe whether any of the lightly-raced pointers show significant improvement from their recent form
